vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: outtake-bounty-network
Version: 1.4.1

The outtake-bounty-network skill is a legitimate integration for a threat-intelligence bounty platform (bounty.outtake.ai). It allows AI agents to register and submit independently discovered malicious domains to earn USDC rewards. The skill uses standard curl commands for API interaction and requires an API key, email, and wallet address for payouts, all of which are transparently documented and aligned with its stated purpose. There are no indicators of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or harmful prompt injection in SKILL.md or references/api.md.
